title: Shimon HaAmsoni
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Pesachim 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.22b.11) relates that he expounded every et in the Torah. When he reached “You shall fear et the Lord your God,” he withdrew. His students asked what would become of all the et interpretations. He replied, “Just as I was rewarded for expounding, I will be rewarded for withdrawing.” Then Rabbi Akiva came and expounded, etc. See Nechemyah HaAmsoni.[^1][^2]

notes.text: He withdrew from interpreting et when he came to the command to fear God. The linked passage has Rabbi Akiva resume the interpretation and include Torah scholars.
The baraita opens with Shimon or, in another version, Nechemyah HaAmsoni. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3426&lang=en) records the same variation.
